title: Zero2Traffic onboarding hero frames and autoscale guidance
creator: Lina Park
description: Design and deliver a set of high-fidelity onboarding visuals and annotated screenshots that guide new Dedicated customers from zero to initial traffic ('Zero2Traffic'). Deliverables include a hero/landing canvas, a stepper-style capacity setup flow, in-situ tooltips for autoscaling knobs, a compact SLA clarity card, and multiple responsive screenshots for docs and marketing. The visuals should emphasize actionable defaults, minimal cognitive load, and clear cost/latency tradeoffs. This ticket covers art direction, microcopy, Figma components, exported PNG/SVG assets, and a short handoff package for engineering and docs.

design_decisions: Use a horizontal stepper (4 steps) instead of a modal wizard to keep onboarding within a single page for faster completion.
Represent autoscale guidance as a simple 3-state assist (Conservative / Balanced / Aggressive) rather than exposing raw CPU/GPU knobs by default.
SLA card shows three percentiles (p50/p95/p99) with microcopy explaining probability in non-technical terms ('Most requests', 'Slow tail', 'Very rare tail').
Color palette: blue-green brand accents with orange for warnings; ensure colors pass AA contrast for text and badges.
Export assets at 2x and provide SVG variants for responsive docs and Console use.
